say:1:1130521001:1.text: Of course! The leader of the Claws bit the dust and the rest tucked tails and ran! What's not to celebrate?
say:1:1130521001:1.source_cn: 当然！流沙之爪的头目倒了，剩下那群乌合之众根本掀不起风...
say:1:1130521001:1.male: Of course! The leader of the Claws bit the dust and the rest tucked tails and ran! What's not to celebrate?
say:1:1130521001:1.female: Of course! The leader of the Claws bit the dust and the rest tucked tails and ran! What's not to celebrate?

say:2:1130521002:1.text: I heard they nabbed a bunch of workers to dig up the treasure for them and then found out it was all a big hoax! What a joke!
say:2:1130521002:1.source_cn: 听说他们为了挖宝抓了不少劳工，结果宝藏都是假的，哈哈！...
say:2:1130521002:1.male: I heard they nabbed a bunch of workers to dig up the treasure for them and then found out it was all a big hoax! What a joke!
say:2:1130521002:1.female: I heard they nabbed a bunch of workers to dig up the treasure for them and then found out it was all a big hoax! What a joke!

say:3:1130521003:1.text: I told Todd all we had to do was bide our time and I was right!
say:3:1130521003:1.source_cn: 我早就跟陶德说过，留在这儿什么都不做才是最正确的！
say:3:1130521003:1.male: I told Todd all we had to do was bide our time and I was right!
say:3:1130521003:1.female: I told Todd all we had to do was bide our time and I was right!
